title: {CLOSED} ABOUT EVENTS: How to create item? How to change event features?

posts.author: BryceTheWho
posts.body:
Greetings.
Have a little fast question here,
I want to create event, or script(?), that will create new item in inventory
after getting two needed for it items. Is it real or not?
I'm very beginner tho.
Also wanted to make events, that appears only after one of conditions.
Example:
Character too small to interact w/ bookshelf, so he push ottoman to it, and after that he can explore bookshelf. Can I do that with rpg maker mv?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Hi, there. Have you done the tutorial included in MV? Have you looked up and done any other tutorials about eventing?
There are a bunch in articles, forum posts, and YouTube videos if you Google it.
BryceTheWho said:
I want to create event, or script(?), that will create new item in inventory
after getting two needed for it items.
Click to expand...
You have a Conditional Branch that checks for the first item, Conditional Branch that checks for the second one, then Change Items to add the third.
BryceTheWho said:
Example:
Character too small to interact w/ bookshelf, so he push ottoman to it, and after that he can explore bookshelf. Can I do that with rpg maker mv?
Click to expand...
There are a bunch of threads and videos about boulder pushing puzzles - how to push an object, check its location, and flip a switch. There was one just last week.
